_dropped.why: Own methodology note states classification is based principally on foreign-trade statistics, i.e. its own part_of container (invalid target). No distinct source named.

The complejos-exportadores note attributes all data to INDEC's Dirección Nacional de Estadísticas del Sector Externo y Cuentas Internacionales — same producing unit as its own container. No distinct target found.
MOA/MOI are classification labels sourced from the same foreign-trade statistics as their own container; no separate methodology document found.

Own methodology note (OPEX_metodologia.pdf) states the primary source is Sistema Informático MARIA / Permisos de embarque, NOT Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior by name. MARIA is a customs computer system, not a corpus node.

IPI minero methodology names Secretaría de Energía SESCO tables and ANSES registers as external sources for hydrocarbons/mining — neither is a corpus node. Only documented dependency is its own container (invalid).
Same IPI minero methodology sourcing issue as ar-litio — Secretaría de Energía is named but is not a corpus node. Only documented dependency is its own container (invalid).

The 'Dotación de personal' report's methodology note states data comes exclusively from sworn declarations (declaraciones juradas) submitted via the GDE system — an administrative registry, not a corpus node. No SIDIF/budget-law citation found.

Press-release methodology section cites only direct monthly price collection (materials, labor, subcontracts) with a 1993 Laspeyres base — no reference to IPC, comercio exterior, or any other corpus node.

INDEC's national IPC methodology only makes the generic statement that 'cada Dirección Provincial de Estadística es responsable del ingreso del relevamiento' without naming which office specifically handles the GBA region (CABA/IDECBA vs. DPE Buenos Aires) — insufficiently specific, and the direct target (ar-ipc) is its own container anyway.

Región Metropolitana de Buenos Aires (RMBA) is not an INDEC-defined statistical term in the sources checked — used by academic/planning bodies (UNGS Observatorio del Conurbano, Observatorio AMBA), not by INDEC with a stated methodology or data lineage.

The context-listed INDEC URL (Nivel4-Tema-4-34-108) returned only navigation-menu content with no report body or linked documents. Likely draws on Ministerio de Seguridad's SNIC or Servicio Penitenciario Federal's SNEEP, neither a corpus node — needs a follow-up pass to locate the actual publication.

Context page (indec.gob.ar Nivel3-Tema-3-9) returned only a generic National Accounts menu with no direct link to this specific satellite table. Title strongly suggests an EPH labour-input dependency, but this could not be verified against real document text — not proposed on inference alone.
